verdict.rationale: LibreChat's own documentation includes a "Scheduled Chats" feature page, which points to first-party scheduling of conversations or agent runs. The pack contains only the page title, though, so recurrence, workflow chaining and how schedules are set up are all unverified. Missing for 10: evidence that schedules can recur (cron/intervals), evidence of scheduling multi-step workflows or agents, configuration and management details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
